# Reconfigurable_Neuromorphic_Architecture

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
An architecture that leverages FPGA reconfigurability to dynamically adapt network topology, neuron parameters, or connectivity patterns for different neuromorphic tasks. Allows iNEST systems to be reprogrammed for diverse applications without hardware redesign, and enables TCC-style topology optimization in real time.
